title: Integrating LLM APIs
subtitle: Authentication, rate limits, retries, and cost management

content.text: Most LLM providers expose a REST API. Use the official SDK, never raw HTTP, for automatic retries and error handling.

content.code:
import anthropic
import os

client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])

try:
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-opus-4-5",
        max_tokens=1024,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
    )
    print(msg.content[0].text)
except anthropic.RateLimitError:
    print("Rate limit hit — back off and retry")
except anthropic.APIStatusError as e:
    print(f"API error {e.status_code}: {e.message}")

content.text: Never hardcode API keys. Load from environment variables or a secrets manager.

questions.question: Where should you store your LLM API key?
options: In an environment variable or secrets manager
questions.explanation: API keys must never be in source code. Use environment variables or a secrets manager like AWS Secrets Manager.

faq.q: How do I reduce API costs?
faq.a: Use caching for repeated prompts, choose smaller models for simpler tasks, reduce max_tokens, and implement prompt caching (prefix caching) where available.
